entities.summary: Albert Roméo "Ab" Renaud, sometimes referred to as Albert Ranaud, was a Canadian ice hockey player. He was a member of the Ottawa RCAF Flyers who won the gold medal in ice hockey for Canada at the 1948 Winter Olympics in St. Moritz.
